headline: Exploring Wilton, Connecticut
subhead: Discover scenic parks, local trails, and historic downtown charm this autumn.
caption: October brings vibrant fall foliage to the historic town of Wilton, Connecticut. Known for its scenic beauty, Wilton features the expansive expanses of Merwin Meadows Park and the peaceful trails at the Weir Farm National Historical Park. Nature enthusiasts also enjoy walking the Norwalk River Valley Trail. The town center offers local shops and dining options, blending historic architecture with everyday convenience. For commuters, Wilton provides access to the Metro-North Railroad as well as major roadways like Route 7 and the Merritt Parkway, connecting the area to neighboring towns and cities. Throughout the year, local seasonal events bring the community together in these charming New England spaces.
